'''Wrea''' was an inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Wrea system/Legends|Wrea system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]]. When [[Kueller]]'s explosive [[Droid/Legends|droids]] decimated the inhabitants of the Run, the [[Wrean/Legends|Wreans]] offered medical assistance. Wrea also contained a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
